To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the existing techniques for 1D extraction from single video sequences are especially efficient for conversion of already available vast 1D view content to 3DTV systems and the multicamera dynamic acquisition techniques are capable of providing 3D reconstruction of dynamic scenes.

the existing 3DTV scene capture technologies are capable to capture dynamic scenes in 3D and that there is a need for a new generation of 3D capture technologies for 3DTV systems that will enable the capture of dynamic scenes with high resolution and at low cost.
the existing techniques for 1D to 3D conversion and dynamic scene reconstruction are still in a stage of development and are far from being ready for the 3DTV applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
development and implementation of novel 3D acquisition and reconstruction methods for dynamic scenes, which will be able to provide a high quality 3D content for 3DTV displays.

the 3DTV is still in its infancy.

the current state of the art of 3D dynamic scene acquisition is very well developed.

the existing 3D dynamic acquisition methods are capable of solving many tasks related to 3DTV.
